Time and Verb Forms explains finished, ongoing, and earlier past actions and modal meanings. Phrases, Clauses, and Punctuation explains standalone thoughts, joining rules, and clause counts.

Nearer-subject agreement is limited to differing numbers with neither/nor or either/or. Singular their is explicitly permitted for unknown or unstated gender.

Independent-clause joining options, comma-splice limits, initial dependent-clause punctuation, and meaningful connectors are stated. Parallel forms apply to items doing the same job and comparisons. Filipino verb choices follow time and intended meaning.
